document.title: BRS-161014 Report test change bond 0930 to 0930S
document.purpose: Check whether bond 0930S can replace bond 0930.
content: Use combined Bonding+Ass'y machine, bonding amount 0.5~0.6mg
Check ass'y condition (SP separate, over glue, stick in jig)

conclusions.statement_from_report: (Decision block at row 64 is empty in the rendered workbook)
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Same-event vs Normal bond 0930: Bonding NG 7.94% vs 1.00% = 7.94x, 694% worse; Visual ass'y NG 40.52% vs 22.0% = 1.84x, 84.2% worse (mostly Over Glue 42 vs 22); Function NG 10.53% vs 11.42% = 0.92x, 7.8% improved (driven by lower Hearing Noise share); Tension AVG higher (Sus C 0.355 vs 0.278 kg, Sus D 0.325 vs 0.277 kg). Bond 0930S improves tension and slightly reduces function NG but greatly increases bonding-process visual NG (Over Glue) – not a clean win.

suggested_checks.check_item: Tune bonding amount when switching to bond 0930S
suggested_checks.reason: Over Glue jumped 22 → 42 and bonding NG jumped 1% → 7.94% same-event. Bond 0930S behaves stickier at the same 0.5-0.6 mg setting.

suggested_checks.check_item: Recheck Hearing Noise vs Touch share
suggested_checks.reason: Test 0930S Hearing Noise 70% of NG vs Normal 84.4%; 0930S shifts NG mix but does not solve hearing noise.

limitations: Visual final and tension samples small (n=5-8).
Decision text not captured in rendered workbook.

assumptions: Normal bond 0930 bonding row OK=50 with NG=1 leaves 49 cells unaccounted; treated as written.
Sample 6-8 missing for Normal bond 0930 tension (n=5).
warnings: Author decision text empty in rendered workbook; conclusion derived from numeric same-event comparison.
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Bonding NG and visual Over Glue both worsen ~7x and ~1.84x same-event; function NG marginally improved; tension improved. Mixed signal so cannot declare adoption.

document.title: BRS-161014 Bond 0930→0930S 변경 테스트 리포트
content: Ass'y 조건 확인(SP separate, over glue, stick jig)

cn1.normalized_interpretation: 동일 이벤트 Normal 대비: Bonding NG 7.94% vs 1.00% = 7.94배, 694% 악화; Visual Ass'y 40.52% vs 22.0% = 1.84배, 84.2% 악화(Over Glue 42 vs 22); Function 10.53% vs 11.42% = 0.92배, 7.8% 개선; Tension은 평균 상승. 본드량 미세조정 없이는 0930S 채택 불가.

h1.reason: 동일 이벤트에서 Over Glue 22→42, Bonding NG 1%→7.94%로 악화. 0930S는 동일 0.5-0.6mg에서 더 끈적.

h2.reason: Test 0930S에서 Noise 70%, Normal 84.4%로 mix만 바뀌고 Hearing Noise 자체는 해결 안 됨.

assumptions: Normal 0930 bonding row OK=50 NG=1, 잔여 49 셀 미기재; 원본대로 사용.
warnings: 원본 결론 텍스트 비어있어 수치 동일 이벤트 비교로 결론 도출.
log.decision_rationale: Bonding/Visual은 7배·1.84배 악화, Function은 미세 개선, Tension은 상승. 혼재 신호로 단정 불가.

document.title: BRS-161014 bond 0930→0930S change test report
document.purpose: Confirm whether bond 0930S can replace bond 0930.
content: Check ass'y conditions (SP separate, over glue, stick jig)

cn1.normalized_interpretation: Same-event vs Normal 0930: Bonding NG 7.94% vs 1.00% = 7.94x, 694% worse; Visual ass'y 40.52% vs 22.0% = 1.84x, 84.2% worse (Over Glue 42 vs 22); Function 10.53% vs 11.42% = 0.92x, 7.8% improved; Tension AVG up. Cannot adopt 0930S without re-tuning bond amount.

h1.check_item: Re-tune bond amount when switching to 0930S
h1.reason: Same-event Over Glue 22→42, bonding NG 1%→7.94%; 0930S behaves stickier at the same 0.5-0.6 mg.

h2.check_item: Re-verify Hearing Noise vs Touch share
h2.reason: Test Noise share 70% vs Normal 84.4%; 0930S only changes NG mix, hearing noise itself not solved.

assumptions: Normal 0930 bonding OK=50, NG=1; remaining 49 not detailed – used as-is.
warnings: Author decision text empty – conclusion built from same-event numeric comparison.
log.decision_rationale: Bonding/Visual worsened 7x and 1.84x, Function slightly improved, Tension up – mixed signal, no clean adoption.

document.title: Báo cáo test đổi keo 0930→0930S – BRS-161014
document.purpose: Kiểm tra xem keo 0930S có thay được keo 0930 không.
content: Máy Bonding+Ass'y kết hợp, lượng keo 0.5~0.6mg
Kiểm tra điều kiện ass'y (SP separate, over glue, stick jig)

cn1.statement_from_report: (Ô kết luận row 64 trống trong workbook)
cn1.normalized_interpretation: So với Normal 0930 cùng sự kiện: Bonding NG 7.94% vs 1.00% = 7.94 lần, xấu 694%; Visual 40.52% vs 22.0% = 1.84 lần, xấu 84.2% (Over Glue 42 vs 22); Function 10.53% vs 11.42% = 0.92 lần, cải thiện 7.8%; Tension AVG tăng. Không thể áp dụng 0930S nếu chưa hiệu chỉnh lại lượng keo.

h1.check_item: Hiệu chỉnh lượng keo khi đổi sang 0930S
h1.reason: Cùng sự kiện Over Glue 22→42, bonding NG 1%→7.94%; 0930S dính hơn ở cùng 0.5-0.6 mg.

h2.check_item: Đối chiếu lại tỷ lệ Hearing Noise/Touch
h2.reason: Tỷ lệ Noise Test 70% vs Normal 84.4% – 0930S chỉ đổi cơ cấu NG, chưa giải quyết hearing noise.

assumptions: Normal 0930 bonding OK=50 NG=1, 49 ô còn lại không chi tiết – giữ nguyên.
warnings: Ô kết luận của tác giả trống – kết luận dựa trên so sánh số liệu cùng sự kiện.
log.decision_rationale: Bonding/Visual xấu 7 và 1.84 lần, Function nhỉnh hơn chút, Tension tăng – tín hiệu hỗn hợp, chưa thể áp dụng.
